title: How many commits deep are you?

selftext: If you don’t know, ask your agent. Report back.

comments.author: SoCal_Hunter
comments.body:
I’m at 36,000 commits.  2700 prompts, 945 design decisions.  Long way to go.

I grew up playing many of the great RPGs and this is my love letter to that history.  Lessons learned from my favorite games: Ultima / Gold Box (esp POR) / Oblivion / Skyrim / BG.

Core systems are mostly done and first continent build out looking good.  Agents self-iterate, play test, and improve and bug test/fix landed work automatically.  Much of the work is in slowly closing the gap to AA/AAA quality.  This is a very difficult problem.  

It will run on iPad too at the very least (Unity) so has required a ton of ongoing optimization work.  Not there yet but in a year this should be pretty incredible.

replies.author: SoCal_Hunter
replies.body: I intend to! It’s getting close to being in a state that I’d be comfortable sharing.  I’d like to do a monthly progress update sort of thing.
